name: Gyakuten Alice ~Fushigi no Kuni no Joou-sama~
original_name: 逆転アリス～不思議の国の女王様～
source:
You went on a trip to England. An unexpected series of events has you wandering into a strange world.

That world just so happens to be the same world as Alice in Wonderland. The residents of this world claim you are the Queen of Hearts.

And then Alice invades the country of Heart! 
Why were you mistaken for the Queen of Hearts? 
Why must you fight Alice?

[from [url=http://www.englishotomegames.net/post/143799693601/reversealice]English Otome Games[/url]]
